entries.cls: Exact hypothesis for the first pair
entries.result: A pair exists iff no separating triangle has black inner boundary, iff t0 is on the black side of every separating triangle. One exact Euler identity proves both directions.
entries.status: PROVED-HERE, independently AI-refereed in structure INTEGRATION.md; human check pending.

entries.cls: Lower bound on the number of good states of a rooted triangulation with a pair
entries.result: Proved lower bound 2m; C1 conjectures 2^m. Independent all-root census through V=22; separator-free tests through V=24. One-cover equality proved; converse open.
entries.status: 2m AI-refereed; C1 finite census, not a theorem.

entries.result: If both contractions at a non-root degree-four vertex have good states, not all matchings of either contraction are exceptional. entries.result: For every pair, the 2n white-graph edges dual to the spokes of r and s split into two spanning trees (Nash-Williams, no signed count). It holds for every choice of one deleted corner per black face, so it never sees the states, and it does not give a good state. Author proof, unreviewed.
